today_submission_quota.caveat: Competition pages state five submissions per day but do not state the quota-reset timezone. Counts above are independently bucketed by UTC and Asia/Taipei date.

official_facts: Only the latest two submissions are tracked.
The latest two submissions are used for final leaderboard evaluation.
The leaderboard shows only the best-scoring bot.
The official team-submissions endpoint currently returns exactly 55680696 and 55680692.
active_slot_rule.replacement_inference: A next valid submission becomes one of the latest two and displaces 55680692, the older current slot, from the tracked pair. A second subsequent valid submission displaces 55680696, leaving the two new submissions as the tracked pair.
active_slot_rule.important_nuance: The Evaluation page also says every submitted bot may continue to play episodes, with newer bots playing much more frequently. Therefore displacement from the tracked/final pair is not asserted to mean an immediate hard stop of every older bot episode.
